nodes.label: Banner Design Rules
nodes.author: claudekit
nodes.rationale: Ads are kept under 20% text because Meta penalizes heavy-text images; print requires 300 DPI, CMYK, 3-5mm bleed for production quality; single CTA bottom-right with min 44px for mobile tap targets.

nodes.label: CIP Design Sub-skill
nodes.author: claudekit
nodes.rationale: Mockups are RECOMMENDED to be generated with an existing logo (image editing) because a real brand mark yields far better deliverables than an AI interpretation; the HTML presentation embeds images as base64 for single-file portability; pro model used for 4K text rendering.

nodes.label: Icon Design Sub-skill
nodes.author: claudekit
nodes.rationale: Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview outputs SVG as XML text, so icon generation needs no image generation API; multi-size export at 16/24/32/48px and 24px viewBox standard keep icons scalable.

nodes.label: Logo Design Sub-skill
nodes.author: claudekit
nodes.rationale: Output logos are ALWAYS generated on a white background so they composite cleanly onto any surface; 55+ styles, 30 color palettes, 25 industry guides with Gemini Nano Banana.

nodes.label: Canvas Visual Design Layer
nodes.author: claudekit
nodes.rationale: Minimal text, maximum visual impact; philosophy-driven design approach with systematic patterns and refined aesthetics

nodes.label: shadcn/ui
nodes.author: claudekit
nodes.rationale: Copy-paste distribution model keeps components in the codebase; TypeScript-first with full type safety; composable via Radix UI primitives

nodes.label: Tailwind CSS
nodes.author: claudekit
nodes.rationale: Utility-first CSS framework with build-time processing and zero runtime overhead; automatic dead code elimination; mobile-first responsive design

nodes.label: Banner Design Principles (3-Zone, Safe Zones, CTA)
nodes.norm_label: banner design principles (3-zone, safe zones, cta)

nodes.label: Color Psychology
nodes.rationale: Colors carry psychological associations mapped to industries (blue=trust for finance/tech, green=growth for eco); pairings, avoid-lists and harmony types (monochromatic/complementary/analogous/triadic) guide palette selection with WCAG AA 4.5:1 contrast.

nodes.label: Logo Types (Wordmark, Lettermark, Pictorial, Abstract, Mascot, Emblem, Combination)
nodes.norm_label: logo types (wordmark, lettermark, pictorial, abstract, mascot, emblem, combination)

nodes.label: Duarte Sparkline Pattern
nodes.rationale: Alternating What Is / What Could Be creates an emotional tension arc; pattern breaks at 1/3 and 2/3 positions create engagement peaks.

nodes.norm_label: dynamic subscription at lease start (inline price_data)

nodes.label: No platform commission (100% rent minus Stripe fees)

nodes.label: CSS Variable System
nodes.rationale: CSS variables in globals.css enable runtime theme switching without rebuilding

nodes.label: HSL Color Format
nodes.rationale: HSL triplets stored without hsl() wrapper give better opacity control via hsl(var(--primary) / 0.5)

nodes.label: Compressed Context Recovery (CCR)
nodes.rationale: Compression is reversible via CCR - originals cached locally and retrievable on demand

nodes.label: Compression Proxy
nodes.rationale: Compresses tool outputs, logs, files and RAG chunks before they reach the LLM - 15-20% fewer tokens for coding agents, 60-95% fewer for JSON
